Per our standard pre-closing routine, I need your reports before I can finalize the approval and set any binding conditions ahead of the proposed November 20, 2026 funding date. Who would like to start?

My review of the October collections file, completed yesterday and still in my working paper pending monthly risk-pack circulation, shows 6% historical dilution rather than the 3% assumed in the draft. Our risk methodology therefore requires an 8% dilution reserve. Additionally, $4,000,000 of the receivables are affiliate balances that must be excluded, leaving an eligible pool of exactly $26,000,000 — not $30,000,000. Both the dilution reserve and the eligible pool size in the draft transaction need to be corrected before we can proceed.
